biotools.summary: The Genomic HyperBrowser was a web server (based on Galaxy) for the analysis of genomic track data (e.g. using feature-specific coordinates relative to reference genome assemblies). It provided statistical methodology and computing power to handle a variety of biological inquires on genomic datasets.

bioschemas.name: The Genomic HyperBrowser
bioschemas.summary: A generic web-based system, providing statistical methodology and computing power to handle a variety of biological inquires on genomic datasets.
